summary: Organigram Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, announcing details of its 2026 OG Investor Session, a digital investor event scheduled to premiere on September 30, 2026. The event will feature presentations from executive leadership, including CEO James Yamanaka, CFO Greg Guyatt, and other executives, covering the company's global growth strategy and strategic priorities. This is a routine investor-relations communication and does not constitute a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate action.
